title: Galant Fête
text:
Scapin, Dreamer,

rubs his kitten

under his protector.


Sweet Columbine,

already expert in love

—do, mi, sol, do—, stirs


the sapping eye

which, suddenly, seeps through,

drunk, its ardor.
editorial_note: The translation keeps the commedia figures, musical syllables, and teasing erotic absurdity.

title: Lily
text:
Oh swings! Oh lilies! Silver chrysobombs!

You who dodge labors and despise hungers!

The detergent love of dawn betrays you

and heavenly sweetnesses smear your stamens!
editorial_note: The translation keeps the invented metallic floral diction and comic impurity of the source.

title: Closed Lips
text:
There is in Rome, in the Sistine,

covered with Christian emblems,

a scarlet display case

where very ancient noses dry,


noses of Thebaid ascetics,

noses of priests of the Grail

where nocturnal consumptives were born

and sepulchral plainchant.


Into their mystical drynesses,

each morning are introduced

the schismatic filths

that are reduced to fine dust.
editorial_note: The translation preserves the grotesque sacred parody of relic-like noses and fine dust.

title: Do You Perhaps Not Imagine...
text:
Do you perhaps not imagine why I die of love?

The flower says to me: Hello! Good morning!, the bird.

Spring has arrived, the sweetness of the angel.

Do you perhaps not guess why I boil with drunkenness!

Sweet angel of my cradle, angel of my granny,

do you perhaps not guess that I turn into a bird,

that my lyre throbs and my wings beat

like a swallow?
editorial_note: The translation keeps the breathless spring intoxication and bird-transformation.

title: Sensation
text:
I will go, when evening sings, blue, in summer,

wounded by wheat, to tread the meadow;

dreamer, I will feel its coolness on my soles

and let the wind bathe my head.


Without speaking, without thinking, I will go along the paths:

but limitless love will grow in my soul.

I will go far away, happy, as with a girl,

through the fields, as far as the gypsy wanders.
editorial_note: The translation preserves the summer walking vision and the limitless love growing in silence.
